title: Relationships
tagline: Build relationships naturally and organically in a world where every character is unique
description:
Relationships allows you to establish and build relationships in a way that feels natural and organic in a SkyrimNet-driven world. Every character has a unique combination of traits and attributes that make them behave and react to you in their own way.

Some characters fall deeply in love but want to save themselves for marriage, while others shun commitment but are open to dating with no strings attached. Getting to know them and treating them accordingly is the whole point, just as in real life. Settings give you control over how quickly relationships progress. Relationships can also regress as warranted.

This applies to both romantic and platonic relationships. Deciding to progress to a romantic relationship requires mutual consent. A successful marriage proposal requires progressing to the highest tier.

Optionally integrates with its companion mod Kinship, so your significant other(s) and children are aware of their relationships to one another and act accordingly. Settings can ensure that your children are blocked from having romantic relations but can still grow their platonic bond.

Requires:
- SkyrimNet Beta 25+
- SKSE64
- Address Library for SKSE Plugins
- PapyrusUtil SE
- powerofthree's Papyrus Extender
- Papyrus MessageBox (Nexus 83578; required for the consent prompt; bundled by MARAS)

Optionally supports:
- Kinship ( for awareness of familial ties )
- M.A.R.A.S. ( for importing existing marriages )
- OStim Community Resource ( for attractiveness rating )
- SeverActions ( for custom bio blocks )
- Meridian UI (non-VR users only)
- Magelight UI
- Prisma UI

Contains no adult content.
author: deadohiosky
changelog:
**A wedding "photographer" and family tree **

- A lore-friendly wedding photographer - Your wedding kiss is painted: when the kiss scene plays, the moment freezes for a breath and an oil painting of the two of you hangs on your spouse's card in the Relationships UI, with a description of what it shows. Turn off "Paint the Wedding Kiss" to keep the camera still at the altar.
- Sit for a painting any time from a spouse's or betrothed's card, standing together or in the middle of an OStim kiss. Your newest painting with each of them stays on their card.
- The wedding kiss is played for you if your betrothed only kisses you in words: OStimNet's kiss first, then Baka's KissLove, or whatever you list under "Wedding Kiss Animations".
- New family tree on the dashboard: spouses past and present, the other parents of your children, and everyone's kids, a branch at a time. Kinship's children included.
- "Leave marriage to their own mod" on a follower's card, for followers whose mod handles marriage itself. Relationships stays out of the way and shows the marriage once it happens.
- Anyone you married the vanilla way before installing now counts as your spouse.
- Lover's Comfort with every spouse, not just the first.
- With Body Language installed, everyone judges your looks against their own tastes, and it feeds into attraction. Choose OCR, Body Language or both under "Attraction Source".
- Removing someone from the roster now offers to block their factions, so nobody else from them is enrolled automatically.
- Adopted children show on cards and in the family tree, and a child is no longer listed twice on a parent's card.
- Fixed: a save made while Relationships was reading a conversation could crash the game every time it loaded.
- Fixed: portraits for characters from plugins with spaces in their names. Uses SeverActions 4.8's portrait API when available.
- All new text translated into the 17 other languages.
